description: This dataset contains sediment core measurements from a single geological event located at 29.0 degrees latitude and -88.333 degrees longitude, with an elevation of -803.5 meters. The records span sediment depths up to 11.83 meters and correspond to ages reaching approximately 41 years. Key variables include stable isotope ratios for Uvigerina species, specifically carbon-13 and oxygen-18, which are critical for paleoclimatology research. All samples were collected during a single event in March 2009. Researchers can use this data to analyze past environmental conditions, reconstruct historical climate patterns, and study sediment deposition rates in this specific marine location.
